verdict.rationale: Managed Kubernetes is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a first-party managed Kubernetes service, an upgrade policy, or autoscaling. The only Kubernetes mention is a community comment about getting a pricing quote for k8s clusters, which does not show the capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, Kubernetes is managed — a first-party managed K8s service with documented upgrade policy and autoscaling
